title: Multi-row view triggering despite plenty of space to not
line: The Task Manager no longer switches to two rows when the panel still has plenty of room for one.
explanation: Since 6.6, TaskList.stripeCount computes how many tasks fit in a row from its parent's size instead of the applet's. The parent (TriangleMouseFilter) is sized to the task list, whose size comes from its own rows and columns, so the count fed back on itself ("Binding loop detected for stripeCount"): once two rows were used the list was half as wide, fewer tasks fit, and it stayed in two rows. The change passes the applet's width and height into TaskList and computes the stripe count from them, as in 6.5.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: Compute the stripe count from the applet's size

The stripe count used the size of the task list's parent, which is sized
from the task list itself, so once two rows were used fewer tasks fit per
row and it stayed in two rows; use the applet's size again as before 6.6.

BUG: 516265

patches.diff:
From b354cdbd4ca4c74a625a57d46d414baf8bd37f85 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:07:41 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: Compute the stripe count from the
 applet's size

The stripe count used the size of the task list's parent, which is sized
from the task list itself, so once two rows were used fewer tasks fit per
row and it stayed in two rows; use the applet's size again as before 6.6.

BUG: 516265
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/TaskList.qml | 12 ++++++++----
 applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml     |  2 ++
 2 files changed, 10 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/TaskList.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/TaskList.qml
index 9c21303298..03de170b25 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/TaskList.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/TaskList.qml
@@ -23,6 +23,10 @@ GridLayout {
     }
 
     required property int count
+    // Size of the whole applet. Don't use the parent's size here: it is derived from
+    // our own rows and columns, which would create a binding loop.
+    required property real availableWidth
+    required property real availableHeight
 
     readonly property bool vertical: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical
 
@@ -40,15 +44,15 @@ GridLayout {
 
         // The maximum number of stripes allowed by the applet's size
         const stripeSizeLimit = vertical
-            ? Math.floor(parent.width / children[0].implicitWidth)
-            : Math.floor(parent.height / children[0].implicitHeight)
+            ? Math.floor(availableWidth / children[0].implicitWidth)
+            : Math.floor(availableHeight / children[0].implicitHeight)
         const maxStripes = Math.min(Plasmoid.configuration.maxStripes, stripeSizeLimit)
 
 
         // The number of tasks that will fill a "stripe" before starting the next one
         const maxTasksPerStripe = vertical
-            ? Math.ceil(parent.height / TaskManagerApplet.LayoutMetrics.preferredMinHeight())
-            : Math.ceil(parent.width / TaskManagerApplet.LayoutMetrics.preferredMinWidth())
+            ? Math.ceil(availableHeight / TaskManagerApplet.LayoutMetrics.preferredMinHeight())
+            : Math.ceil(availableWidth / TaskManagerApplet.LayoutMetrics.preferredMinWidth())
 
         return Math.min(Math.ceil(count / maxTasksPerStripe), maxStripes)
     }
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
index d0a62d21bc..3dc43deafc 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
@@ -473,6 +473,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                 }
 
                 count: tasksModel.count
+                availableWidth: tasks.width
+                availableHeight: tasks.height
 
                 readonly property real widthOccupation: taskRepeater.count / columns
                 readonly property real heightOccupation: taskRepeater.count / rows
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: text Task Manager, multi-row when low on space, 3 launchers and 2 windows in two rows with ~1000 px free
With the fix: same setup in one row

reviews.text: Correctly fixes the Plasma 6.6 regression where TaskList.stripeCount computed capacity from parent.width/height (TriangleMouseFilter, which is sized from TaskList itself), creating a binding loop that trapped the Task Manager in two rows despite ample free panel space. Passing the applet's availableWidth and availableHeight from main.qml breaks the loop cleanly, matches how taskList's own size is computed, and is thoroughly verified across text and icons-only modes.

Right root cause: the linting commit 4ff172a0f4 replaced tasks.width/height with parent.width/height in TaskList.stripeCount, and the parent (TriangleMouseFilter) is sized from the task list, so the stripe count fed back on itself; 6.5.5 used the applet size exactly as this patch does again. Passing the applet size in as required properties fits the linting style, removes the binding-loop warnings, and the before/after shots show two rows collapsing to one with lots of free space, with regressions (more windows, icons-only, narrow panel) checked. Nit: the commit message could name 4ff172a0f4 as the regressing change; with 'fill' off the applet's preferred width still derives from the task list, as it did in 6.5.
